turns.message: I ordered a riding jacket for Rs. 7350 and a mosquito mesh for Rs. 799 on Amazon. I was not happy with them and asked to return both. The pickup agent first marked the items as not ready without calling me, and customer service rescheduled the pickup for three days later. The jacket was then marked as picked up but the mesh was not. After I kept calling customer care, they told me that when the parcel reached their hub it had a mosquito mesh in it instead of the jacket. They promised the refund by August 16th, then said there would be an update by August 19th, and on August 19th they told me the refund was cancelled because the wrong item was sent.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date (the August dates have no year).
